verses.translation: For the end, a Psalm of David.

translations.ron: Scoate-mă, Doamne, de la omul viclean şi de omul nedrept mă izbăveşte,
translations.grk: Εἰς τὸ τέλος, τῷ Δαυὶδ ψαλμός.

verses.translation: Rescue me, O Lord, from the evil man; deliver me from the unjust man.

translations.ron: Care gândeau nedreptate în inimă, toată ziua îmi duceau război.
translations.grk: Ἐξελοῦ με Κύριε ἐξ ἀνθρώπου πονηροῦ, ἀπὸ ἀνδρὸς ἀδίκου ῥῦσαί με·

verses.translation: Who have devised injustice in their hearts; all the day they prepared war.

translations.ron: Ascuţit-au limba lor ca a şarpelui; venin de aspidă sub buzele lor.
translations.grk: οἵτινες ἐλογίσαντο ἀδικίας ἐν καρδίᾳ, ὅλην τὴν ἡμέραν παρετάσσοντο πολέμους.

verses.translation: They have sharpened their tongue as the tongue of a serpent; the poison of asps is under their lips. Pause.

translations.ron: Păzeşte-mă, Doamne, de mâna păcătosului; scoate-mă de la oamenii nedrepţi, care au gândit să împiedice paşii mei.
translations.grk: Ἠκόνησαν γλῶσσαν αὐτῶν ὡσεὶ ὄφεως, ἰὸς ἀσπίδων ὑπὸ τὰ χείλη αὐτῶν· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: Keep me, O Lord, from the hand of the sinner; rescue me from unjust men; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.

translations.ron: Pusu-mi-au cei mândri cursă mie şi funii; curse au întins picioarelor mele; pe cărare mi-au pus pietre de poticneală.
translations.grk: Φύλαξόν με Κύριε ἐκ χειρὸς ἁμαρτωλοῦ, ἀπὸ ἀνθρώπων ἀδίκων ἐξελοῦ με· οἵτινες ἐλογίσαντο τοῦ ὑποσκελίσαι τὰ διαβήματά μου.

verses.translation: The proud have hid a snare for me, and have stretched out ropes for snares for my feet; they set a stumbling-block for me near the path. Pause.

translations.ron: Zis-am Domnului: "Dumnezeul meu eşti Tu, ascultă, Doamne, glasul rugăciunii mele".
translations.grk: Ἔκρυψαν ὑπερήφανοι παγίδα μοι· καὶ σχοινία διέτειναν παγίδας τοῖς ποσί μου, ἐχόμενα τρίβου σκάνδαλον ἔθεντό μοι· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: I said to the Lord, Thou art my God; hearken, O Lord, to the voice of my supplication.

translations.ron: Doamne, Doamne, puterea mântuirii mele, umbrit-ai capul meu în zi de război.
translations.grk: Εἶπα τῷ Κυρίῳ, Θεός μου εἶ σὺ· ἐνώτισαι, Κύριε, τὴν φωνὴν τῆς δεήσεώς μου.

verses.translation: O Lord God, the strength of my salvation; thou hast screened my head in the day of battle.

translations.ron: Să nu mă dai pe mine, Doamne, din pricina poftei mele, pe mina păcătosului; viclenit-au împotriva mea; să nu mă părăseşti, ca să nu se trufească.
translations.grk: Κύριε Κύριε, δύναμις τῆς σωτηρίας μου, ἐπεσκίασας ἐπὶ τὴν κεφαλήν μου ἐν ἡμέρᾳ πολέμου.

verses.translation: Deliver me not, O Lord, to the sinner, according to my desire: they have devised mischief against me; forsake me not, lest they should be exalted. Pause.

translations.ron: Vârful laţului lor, osteneala buzelor lor să-i acopere pe ei!
translations.grk: Μὴ παραδῷς με, Κύριε, ἀπὸ τῆς ἐπιθυμίας μου ἁμαρτωλῷ· διελογίσαντο κατʼ ἐμοῦ, μὴ ἐγκαταλίπῃς με, μή ποτε ὑψωθῶσι· διάψαλμα.

verses.translation: As for the head of them that compass me, the mischief of their lips shall cover them.

translations.ron: Să cadă peste ei cărbuni aprinşi; în foc aruncă-i pe ei, în necazuri, pe care să nu le poată răbda.
translations.grk: Ἡ κεφαλὴ τοῦ κυκλώματος αὐτῶν, κόπος τῶν χειλέων αὐτῶν καλύψει αὐτούς.

verses.translation: Coals of fire shall fall upon them on the earth; and thou shalt cast them down in afflictions: they shall not bear up under them.

translations.ron: Bărbatul limbut nu se va îndrepta pe pământ; pe omul nedrept răutatea îl va duce la pieire.
translations.grk: Πεσοῦνται ἐπʼ αὐτοὺς ἄνθρακες πυρὸς ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς, καὶ καταβαλεῖς αὐτοὺς ἐν ταλαιπωρίαις, οὐ μὴ ὑποστῶσιν.

verses.translation: A talkative man shall not prosper on the earth: evils shall hunt the unrighteous man to destruction.

translations.ron: Ştiu că Domnul va face judecată celui sărac şi dreptate celor sărmani;
translations.grk: Ἀνὴρ γλωσσώδης οὐ κατευθυνθήσεται ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς· ἄνδρα ἄδικον κακὰ θηρεύσει εἰς καταφθοράν.

verses.translation: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the poor, and the right of the needy ones.

translations.ron: Iar drepţii vor lăuda numele Tău şi vor locui cei drepţi în faţa Ta.
translations.grk: Ἔγνων ὅτι ποιήσει Κύριος τὴν κρίσιν τοῦ πτωχοῦ, καὶ τὴν δίκην τῶν πενήτων.

verses.translation: Surely the righteous shall give thanks to thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

translations.grk: Πλὴν δίκαιοι ἐξομολογήσονται τῷ ὀνόματί σου, κατοικήσουσιν εὐθεῖς σὺν τῷ προσώπῳ σου.
